summary: P-SOL-v1 design (runs/RUN-20260823T191900Z-b9f8f80d/kimi-k3-main-design.md): the redesigned main experiment after the substrate map invalidated the naive panel+hazard plan. Specified the PanelRecordV2 layout, the G0 continuation-engine fidelity ladder with its kill rule (Kendall-tau LB >= 0.85) and 64-root mini-ladder, KM hazard/lifetime labels over K=16 CRN continuations at H=48, the within-root pairwise ranking loss on the deployed KM-lifetime scalar with SE-scaled pair weights, the G1 gate calibrated by exact D1/D2 anchors with the incumbent-plus-0.03 McNemar bar, the G2 target-vs-fit decomposition, seed arithmetic and CPU-hour budget (32.45 to the gate), stop rules, the implementer file list, rejected alternatives, scale-out boundary and stated priors (P(G0)=0.90, P(G1|G0)=0.40, overall ~0.20). Produced over four sessions; the first three crashed silently in opencode during file reads and the final design was produced from a fully inlined brief.
validationPerformed: Read-only design session; no file modified, no build, no seed read
